title: Fix broken documentation links and add automated link validation
body:
## Fix broken documentation links and add automated link validation

Fixes broken documentation links and adds automated link validation using lychee-action for fumadocs documentation.

## Changes

**Validation tooling:**
- `.github/workflows/check-links.yml` - Lychee-based link checker that runs on push to main and PRs, fails CI on broken links
- `lychee.toml` - Configuration file with path remapping to validate internal fumadocs links (maps Next.js routes `/docs/*` to filesystem paths `docs/*` using regex)
- `.lycheeignore` - Ignore patterns for lychee (localhost, example.com, social media links)

**Documentation:**
- CONTRIBUTING.md - Link conventions with examples

**Fixed broken links:**
- ✅ docs/index.md - Fixed ALL internal links to include `/docs/` prefix (Quick Links, hero actions, Getting Started, Components, Core Concepts, Plugins, Reference, Architecture, Ecosystem, Support, Community, CTA buttons)
- ✅ plugin-editor.mdx - Added `/docs/` prefix to internal links
- ✅ plugin-kanban.mdx - Added `/docs/` prefix to internal links
- ✅ plugin-charts.mdx - Added `/docs/` prefix to internal links
- ✅ plugin-markdown.mdx - Fixed `/api` → `/docs/reference/api/core`, added `/docs/` prefix, updated external references
- ✅ plugin-object.mdx - Added `/docs/` prefix to internal links, removed `.md` extensions
- ✅ navigation-menu.mdx - Fixed example hrefs to include `/docs/` prefix

## Link conventions

In fumadocs with `baseUrl: '/docs'`, the baseUrl defines where docs are served in Next.js routing (`app/docs/[[...slug]]/page.tsx`). Internal links **MUST** include the `/docs/` prefix to match the actual URL structure:

```markdown
✅ [Quick Start](/docs/guide/quick-start)      # Correct - served at /docs/guide/quick-start
✅ [API Reference](/docs/reference/api/core)   # Correct - served at /docs/reference/api/core

❌ [Quick Start](/guide/quick-start)           # Wrong - results in 404
```

**Why this matters**: The `baseUrl` parameter tells fumadocs where the docs are mounted in the Next.js app structure. Links must use the full path that matches the actual URL where pages are accessible.

## Validation Status

**Lychee link checker** with `lychee.toml` configuration:
- Validates all HTTP/HTTPS links are not broken (checks for 404s)
- **Path remapping**: Uses regex to map Next.js routes (`/docs/*`) to filesystem paths (`docs/*`)
  - Pattern: `^/docs/(.*)$ file://./docs/$1`
  - Lychee automatically tries common extensions (.md, .mdx, etc.)
  - Handles index files automatically
- Scans `docs/**/*.{md,mdx}` and `README.md`
- Checks both internal and external links
- **Fails CI** if broken links are found, blocking code merge
- Ignores localhost, example.com, and social media links
- Runs on push to main and on pull requests
